verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://docs.growthbook.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200. It indexes a 202-page LLM-oriented docs bundle at /_llms/docs.txt, and the docs are also served as markdown at /_llms/docs.md and page-level .md URLs. GrowthBook also ships Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) through its MCP server, which is further agent-oriented guidance. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the llms.txt offering, and independent or community reports of agents using it in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.growthbook.io/llms.txt # GrowthBook Documentation
it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails)
